role: Internal technical reviewer; Root alone executes archive/restore, stages and pushes. No archive script execution/import, SDK/native/provider actions or canonical edits by reviewer.

source_checks.parts: Ordered exclusive 40MiB chunks; each size/hash and whole compressed archive size/hash. 40MiB means 41943040bytes, not less than40decimalMB.
source_checks.restore: Fresh destination; verified ordered chunks; exact expected member names/no duplicates; only regular files or backward hardlinks to already verified hash/mode-compatible entries. Each member size/SHA256/mode and final complete pathset checked.
source_checks.metadata: Mode preserved; ACL/xattrs/ownership/restored timestamps are not claimed. Previous-file reuse claims byte/size only.
source_checks.execution: assert-based checks require ordinary Python without -O/PYTHONOPTIMIZE. Hash-bound trusted checkpoint manifests, not arbitrary adversarial archive input. Prospective outputs absent at review. Failed partial attempt is not accepted; no source review implies actual archive success.
